These operators are dual in that they both constrain and validate input/output spaces. Failure modes include data inconsistency, violation of rest thresholds, and insufficient reasoning depth. Temporal alignment of game dates and rest periods implies a time-series dependency that GSE models via state transitions. GSI applies Bayesian inference to update beliefs about edge likelihoods, while GSE uses these primitives to compute optimal actions in real-time.
